brief.H1: Keep samurai kabuto subject and slate frame; indigo lacquer bowl, red crescent horns, green jade crest and crimson cord.
brief.Wild: Replace youthful monkey with mature hooded Goboomana gorilla identity, crimson headband and indigo scarf, preserving frame and left streaming headband tails.
brief.split_symbols: Apply the same H1 and Wild designs to both overlapping motifs; mirror foreground Wild to face left.
brief.head_v2: Compact broad gorilla head matching Boomana original anatomy and head-to-body proportions, rounded close-fitting indigo hood, narrow crimson band above eyebrows; both eyes fully visible with amber irises, pupils, pale sclera and highlights, referencing Anubis open-face hood. No vertical stretching, no pointed crown, no eye obstruction.
brief.Wild_v2: Match corrected compact gorilla head, short broad muzzle and exposed amber eyes in Wild and both mirrored split portraits; preserve slate frames, streaming red headband tails and indigo scarf layout for mesh animation.

native_layer_fixes_v3.waist: Torso hem and red sash drawn above thigh attachments to prevent clipped tails.
native_layer_fixes_v3.banana: Clean PSD residual alpha, move +18,-17 px to new mouth, bind banana and lip overlay to same head transform.
native_layer_fixes_v3.shuriken: Move jade star from hand to armL shoulder; one blade occluded by torso and sleeve; visible throughout all animations.

motion_v4.cloth: Continuous weighted jacket mesh, pinned waistband, independent hem and sash chains with physics and seamless 4.8s accessory loop.
motion_v4.split: Authored guard, diagonal strike at 0.32s and damped recovery; alternate clip restarts repeated cuts; finale receives stronger accent.
motion_v4.rare_trigger: Two strikes at 0.56s and 1.02s synchronized to audio.
motion_v4.transitions: Smooth monotone cubic keys, softer return to idle, quiet dance loop; turbo shares reel timing.
motion_v4.validation: 60fps clip sweep, 120fps mixed transitions, exact rest-art registration and non-inverting inked triangles.

presentation_v6.idle: 2.3s board glance and guard adjustment, spaced 11s apart and interruptible by feature actions.
presentation_v6.reactions: Queue big-win cheer until slash/throw completion; exit celebration immediately when its presentation closes.
presentation_v6.split_fx: Red/gold directional fragments, wider finale fan, monotonic reveal fade; reset cancels pending sound cues and stale split continuations.
presentation_v6.big_win: Single cancellable RAF clock drives plaque, damped shake, scale punch and brief flash; no overlapping timer remnants on skips or tier changes.
presentation_v6.validation: Additional 120fps watch-to-cut and scatter-to-cheer transition mesh checks.

sword_energy_v7.renderer: Native additive Pixi geometry outside reel lighting, centred on board; tapered curved silhouette, three bloom layers, white razor core, staggered filaments and ballistic splinters.
sword_energy_v7.timing: 110ms anticipation hairline, 150-320ms travel, peak contact at 320ms, peel-away recovery to 740ms; same 0.6 Turbo factor as character and reels.
sword_energy_v7.lifecycle: One effect per lead reel, latest cut replaces current effect, clear/restore/unmount cancel the RAF; input passes through the layer.
sword_energy_v7.preview: sword_slash.gif uses the actual geometry function over representative symbol art; this is an effect review, not a game screenshot.

all_straps_v5.covered: Both headband tails, both sleeve tails, lateral waist sash, existing front sash tails, both ties on each shin, loose heel tie.
all_straps_v5.binding: Original 25 body joints preserved; new free-end chains append to the skeleton. Knots and wound wraps stay pinned; visible ends receive phase-lagged breeze and inertial physics.
all_straps_v5.base_skin: Fine meshes preserve barycentric weighted local positions so original cuff and shoulder deformations are unchanged.
all_straps_v5.checks: All visible groups own painted vertices and move independently. Source registration, 60fps poses and 120fps mixed/ Turbo transitions checked.
